lifecycle_review.stingray: Earthwork, grading, pad preparation and underground electrical work all underway; deck page 10 matches. Delivery forecast 1H 2027 is not selected.
lifecycle_review.black_pearl_phase_ii: Phase II concrete foundations, building steel and underground electrical in progress; deck page 8 matches. Phase I first capacity delivered in August with rent commenced is a separate, unselected project on the same campus.
lifecycle_review.successor_review: Research-lane review of Cipher's releases from August 4 to August 20 found only an unrelated August 10 statement; no Stingray or Phase II completion or cancellation. Bounded, not exhaustive.
lifecycle_review.scope: Broad under_construction only; no capacity, tenant role, workload or operating model is normalized.

identity_review.stingray: Cipher's June 15 Form 8-K indenture defines the Stingray Datacenter Facility Site as about 250 acres at 110 SW 9001, Andrews, Texas; the state environmental registry lists STINGRAY at physical location 110 SW 9001, Andrews County. The indenture ZIP 79717 and registry near-ZIP 79714 differ; the match relies on house number, street and county. Round15 had rejected directory use of SW 9001 as a corridor; the issuer's own filing now names the exact address.
identity_review.black_pearl: The state environmental registry lists BLACK PEARL DATA CENTER at 11786 CR 209, Wink, with Cipher Black Pearl LLC as owner and operator under a data-hosting NAICS code. Cipher's deck lists Cipher Black Pearl LLC as an operating entity and its Q2 10-Q describes the 300 MW Black Pearl Facility in Wink. This bridges the address to the data-centre campus, not only an ancillary building.
identity_review.campus_scope: Each address locates one campus. Black Pearl Phase I and Phase II count once; Barber Lake and Cipher's other sites are separate and are not merged.

independent_geometry_review.recapture: Root captures on September 25 of both outSR=4326 queries are byte-identical to the research lane's captures; native-CRS queries and the layer metadata were captured separately.
independent_geometry_review.native_crs: WKID 102100 / latest WKID 3857 (WGS84 Web Mercator), from the layer metadata and each native response.
independent_geometry_review.reproduction: Inverse spherical Web Mercator on a = 6378137 m reproduces the server's WGS84 point to within 1e-12 degrees for both addresses. No datum transformation is involved.
independent_geometry_review.address_authority: Both points carry source CSEC (Commission on State Emergency Communications). TxGIO states each authoritative source has its own placement guideline and that TxGIO does not edit the points.
independent_geometry_review.black_pearl_crosscheck: The research lane reported that a separate TCEQ record for the older Black Pearl mining project carries a GPS point about 0.57 km away with no stated datum; it is not selected.
independent_geometry_review.uncertainty_caveat: Address points are 9-1-1 routing locations, not surveyed campus boundaries, parcels, building footprints or work extents.

distinctness_review.alias_note: The token 9001 matched only unrelated numeric substrings in three Finnish and Colorado rows; no Cipher, Stingray, Black Pearl, Andrews or Wink match exists.
